question: As of 2024, in which of the following cities is the headquarters of Axis Bank located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Corporate Office of Axis Bank is located at Axis House Mumbai**.
 
• Axis Bank is **the third largest private sector bank operating in India**.
 
• The bank was established in **1993** and began its operations in 1994.
